sermon.title: Go and Teach 12/01/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer preaches the Great Commission: all authority is Christ’s, so teach all nations to observe what He commanded. That teaching covers life now: education, work, savings, waiting for marriage, honoring parents, and loving as 1 Corinthians 13 describes. Books can’t change a marriage; Christ changes people from the inside.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics and studies cited are kept as spoken and were not checked.
